name: dsh-context-handoff
description: Token-aware context handoff for DeepSeek Harness: summarize a long session into a Markdown file, compare continue-versus-switch token costs, switch auto mode from the sidebar, and resume in a fresh session.
author: dsh-context-handoff contributors

compatibility.note: Verified against DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.3: host bundle composition, config-schema import, plugin load, /handoff command registration, client bundle present in the Web boot graph and served from /plugins. Sidebar tab/pane registration is covered by the client bundle test; command execution, model calls, auto-state, and the new-session path are covered by the test suite with stubbed services.
